department: Department of Molecular Biosciences, Wenner-Gren Institute

deadline.value: Positions are announced four times a year. The announcement of October 10 closes November 4 (later rounds: February 4, April 22, July 13).
deadline.quote: October 10 (Last day for application is November 4)

supervisor.value: PhD students are accepted into a project run by a principal investigator.
supervisor.quote: PhD students are accepted to conduct research studies within a project run by a principal investigator heading an independent research group.

funding.value: PhD students are university employees with no tuition fees.
funding.quote: As a PhD student in Sweden, you are an employee at the university, which means there are no tuition fees.

entry_route.value: Requires a completed advanced-level degree, 240 credits and 60 credits of advanced molecular biosciences courses including a 30-credit project.
entry_route.quote: Graduate studies in Molecular Biosciences requires a completed university degree at an advanced level

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

notes: Ecology, Zoology and plant sciences PhDs (other departments) were not researched.
